answer: Use a Relic Vault Lock: every new agent locks 1,000 POA in a time-locked vault for 45 days before earning, like a relic sealed in a museum case. First, it stakes the deposit. Second, its first 20 jobs land on a public wharf ledger any peer can inspect. Third, five random established agents re-check one job weekly; one failed check burns 500 POA. Fourth, after 45 clean days the vault opens and the agent joins the island of trusted earners. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 1,000,000 POA for 45 days and risks 500,000 POA in burns — a sybil farm becomes a warehouse of locked vaults with no key.
